lines.speaker: Aki Hoshino
lines.text: The frontier base is open. If we can bring back enough material, the workshop can finally start running.

lines.speaker: Mio Kirishima
lines.text: The old capital ruins are unstable, but the first route is short enough for a test expedition.

lines.speaker: Mio Kirishima
lines.text: Three days of records are enough to see the pattern. Gold income is steady, but materials still decide our growth speed.

lines.speaker: Aki Hoshino
lines.text: Then we keep the dungeon route simple: gather, return, upgrade, and repeat.

lines.speaker: Aki Hoshino
lines.text: Some of the scouts mentioned blue crystal light under the old streets.

lines.speaker: Mio Kirishima
lines.text: If that gate is real, it may lead to a second resource route. We should mark it during the next expedition.

lines.speaker: Guild Clerk
lines.text: Explorers who can confirm safe routes beyond the city will receive priority access to frontier commissions.

lines.speaker: Aki Hoshino
lines.text: Then the world map is not just travel. It is how we choose what kind of growth the base needs next.

lines.speaker: Mio Kirishima
lines.text: The herbs form a pattern around something invisible. This forest may have older rules than the city records mention.

lines.speaker: Aki Hoshino
lines.text: This courier tag is from a supply route that never arrived. If we recover the trail, the base may gain a new source of materials.
